comparison.objective: Clamp an aluminium workpiece, drill through its marked location, and leave the drill safe.
comparison.physical_skill: Align and tighten a clamp, operate drill controls and feed, and maintain clearance from rotating tooling.
comparison.success_condition: Hole drilled through within position tolerance while clamped, no unsafe proximity or loose-part event, drill stopped/up, workpiece still clamped.
comparison.reason: Tests fixturing, machining, and rotating-tool safety, not bimanual sifting or selective many-body recovery.
